summary: Iteration-4 frontend verification of NEGOTIA's 3 new features - all PASS. (1) Russian opponent names: left ОППОНЕНТЫ panel shows 'Елена Ростова' (Вице-президент по закупкам) + 'Марк Соколов' (Юрисконсульт) for enterprise-discount / Запрос корпоративной скидки. AI reply author labels also use Russian names ['Елена Ростова', 'Марк Соколов', ...]. Trust/Доверие moved from initial 50 -> 55 for BOTH participants after 3 Russian messages (Раунд 0 -> 2), proving neg.state.trust is keyed by the localized names (state key match confirmed). Pressure stayed at 30 in this run (empathy-heavy content), but it is keyed correctly. (2) Push-to-talk voice: in a fresh voice-mode negotiation (Режим VOICE confirmed in UI), pressing pointer down on btn-mic switches the button to rose-ring + animate-pulse class and the msg-input placeholder becomes 'Слушаю... отпустите, чтобы отправить'; on pointerup after 2.8s a single POST /api/voice/transcribe multipart fires and the transcribed text is auto-sent as a NEW user bubble (bubbles 0 -> 1, input cleared to ''), triggering AI replies from Елена Ростова + Марк Соколов in Russian. No 'Нет доступа к микрофону' toast (Chromium fake-media + grant_permissions(['microphone'])). (3) Dynamic coaching: with coach-toggle enabled, POST /api/coach/hint fired after messages and returned {hint, framework:'Combined', dynamic:true}. Two consecutive hints were CONTEXTUAL Russian tips referencing the actual conversation: hint1='Задайте SPIN-вопрос: уточните, что конкретно входит в предложение конкурента и какие риски они уже оценили при переходе.' hint2='Задайте SPIN-вопрос: спросите, какие конкретные потери в SLA-инцидентах у них уже случались, переведите риск в цифры.' — different text, references SLA/конкурент from transcript, proving dynamic Claude-grounded generation (not static). The coach-hint banner renders inside NegotiationRoom with data-testid='coach-hint'.

verified_flows.russian_names_in_sidebar_and_ai_labels: PASS - Елена Ростова / Марк Соколов render with Russian roles (Вице-президент по закупкам, Юрисконсульт); AI message author labels show the same Russian names.
verified_flows.trust_pressure_bars_update: PASS - Trust 50 -> 55 for BOTH participants after Russian empathy/anchor messages, confirming state.trust keys match the localized name strings used for display. Раунд counter also went 0 -> 2.
verified_flows.push_to_talk_hold_recording: PASS - onPointerDown starts recording (rose ring + animate-pulse + placeholder 'Слушаю... отпустите, чтобы отправить'); onPointerUp fires exactly one POST /api/voice/transcribe (multipart); startRecording/stopRecording split works.
verified_flows.voice_mode_auto_send: PASS - In voice mode (neg.mode === 'voice'), transcribed text is auto-sent as a new user message bubble (input cleared, bubble count +1) and AI reply streams back from the Russian-named participants.
verified_flows.dynamic_coach_hint: PASS - /api/coach/hint returns dynamic:true with contextual Russian tips; two consecutive hints differ and reference the ongoing negotiation (SLA, conkurent 30% discount, SPIN). data-testid 'coach-hint' banner updates on every message.

critical_code_review_comments: NegotiationRoom.jsx: When user toggles the 'Coaching' checkbox and immediately clicks send, the first send's closure may still see coaching=false (observed: first hint call skipped in test). Minor UX gap - hint appears from the 2nd message. Consider reading coaching from a ref, or calling coachHint on toggle-on as well.
coachHint failures are silently swallowed (try/catch {}). Consider surfacing a subtle toast on error so users know coaching is intermittently unavailable.
onPointerLeave stops recording even for accidental micro-movements while holding the button on hover. Could cause unintended cut-offs on desktop; consider a small dead-zone or use pointercancel only.
backend/server.py remains >900 lines - recommend splitting into routers (auth, scenarios, negotiations, voice, coach).
TTS body still sends voice: null when only gender is chosen (harmless but noisy).
seed_data_creation: Test created 2 negotiations under demo user (1 chat, 1 voice). No cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard is step-based (step 1 scenario, 2 framework, 3 mode, 4 participants, 5 prep). When automating, DO NOT try to click w-mode-voice / w-parts-N on the first page after start-<slug>; you must first click wizard-next until w-mode-* testids are visible, then select, then click wizard-next again to reach parts step. Otherwise mode silently stays default 'chat' and voice auto-send won't trigger. Push-to-talk: use page.mouse.down()/up() over btn-mic bounding box (page.hover then mouse.down/up) - onPointerDown/onPointerUp handlers work as expected with Chromium fake-media. Login route /auth, Negotiation route /negotiation/:id, Russian is default UI language.
